propositions: Outbound creates currently fail closed to a single construction-time project value, preventing multi-project dispatch when a mapping lists multiple valid projects.
The cross-project guard aborts pre-flight on any target outside a single configured project, treating valid out-of-set mutations as misconfiguration.
Create targets must be resolved once from the local ticket's bridge_project field and stamped into the mutation, covering both Cloud and Data Center transports from a single site.
The cross-project guard must relax from equality check to set membership check against the mapping's project set, while preserving fail-closed behavior for unknown projects.
Reserved key _bridge_target_project must be read by both transports from the payload and dropped before Data Center sends it to Jira to prevent HTTP 400 field errors.
